text:
sre-ana: alert fired: hosted-infer-usw2 gateway p99 latency + 5xx fraction spike at 2026-03-16T14:02Z :rotating_light:
observability-bot: SLO: gateway.p99 >= 800ms (slo-burn = 13%)
support-jamie: customers reporting API timeouts and 502s, ticket #ENG-9812 attached
ingress-max: I'm seeing a burst of multiplexed connections, backend pool reports connections_active ~= 650 -> 1024 limit then retries
sre-ana: opening traces — many roots have no downstream spans (trace-gap). sample id: 0a1b2c3d4e
platform-lee: could be proxy pool starvation. recent config change increased `max_concurrent_streams` on proxy but we rolled kernel bump last deploy 2h before spike
ingress-max: query (logs): ```
logfmt | service:proxy-ingress | level:warn | message~"stream limit" | count():group_by[minute]
```
sre-ana: logs show repeated `http2: stream reset` from upstream with code=REFUSED_STREAM and `connection: keep-alive` churn
support-jamie: repro steps from one customer: send 300 parallel small requests with keepalive true -> 30% fail within 2 min
platform-lee: I can replicate locally using `wrk2` script, will paste later
ingress-max: quick mitigation: lowering `worker_concurrency`? also consider temporary reducing multiplexed streams per connection to 128 instead of 512
sre-ana: agree. also enable fallback route to single-request upstream cluster for premium tenants until fix
deploy-bot: deploy started: ingress/proxy-config v2026.03.16-7a9d (who: platform-lee)
platform-lee: deployed config change to reduce `max_concurrent_streams` to 128 in us-west-2 proxy pool. watch dashboards
observability-bot: dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/ingress-usw2/gateway-metrics?orgId=1&from=now-1h&to=now
sre-ana: after change p99 dropped from 1.2s -> 320ms within 4 minutes, 5xx fraction down from 6.1% -> 0.8% :thumbsup:
ingress-max: still seeing some trace gaps for older requests; likely retransmit storms. adding temporary client-retry-rate-limit in front of gateway
support-jamie: updating affected customers with workaround (disable keepalive / reduce concurrency). will escalate if they continue
platform-lee: root cause hypothesis: multiplexing starvation under burst + a regression in kernel-level epoll wake handling from last infra kernel bump. filing infra bug and scheduling revert test
sre-ana: follow-ups: (1) add a probe that simulates 300 concurrent keepalive requests to detect regression, (2) add alert that correlates `REFUSED_STREAM` rate with p99, (3) postmortem template assigned to @sre-ana
observability-bot: created ticket OBS-5023: add synthetic test + correlated alert
sre-ana: tl;dr: transient proxy multiplexing starvation caused upstream reset storms and trace gaps. mitigated by reducing `max_concurrent_streams` and adding client-side rate-limit fallback. continuing root-cause investigation. :white_check_mark:
